ec066b683d33c94b7087353435542ebb1e781db6.statement: A request is accepted exactly when its room is free for its whole time.
ec066b683d33c94b7087353435542ebb1e781db6.formula:
(∀ (x : Booking), (∀ (x_1 : World), ((accepted x x_1) = (Rooms.free (booked x_1) x))))

@[frflow_defs] def free (x : (List Booking)) (x_1 : Booking) : Prop :=
  (∀ x_2 ∈ x, (Rooms.apart x_2 x_1))

@[frflow_defs] def apart (x : Booking) (x_1 : Booking) : Prop :=
  ((¬(x.room = x_1.room)) ∨ (∀ (x_2 : Int), (¬((Rooms.covers x x_2) ∧ (Rooms.covers x_1 x_2)))))

@[frflow_defs] def covers (x : Booking) (x_1 : Int) : Prop :=
  ((x.start ≤ x_1) ∧ (x_1 < x.«end»))

d588814189a90614b5bbd87823b3fb32e224d1a0.statement: A request is booked exactly when its room is free for its whole time.
d588814189a90614b5bbd87823b3fb32e224d1a0.formula:
(∀ (x : Booking), (∀ (x_1 : World), ((bookedAfter x x_1) = (if (Rooms.free (booked x_1) x) then ((booked x_1) ++ [x]) else (booked x_1)))))

@[frflow_defs] def free (x : (List Booking)) (x_1 : Booking) : Prop :=
  (∀ x_2 ∈ x, (Rooms.apart x_2 x_1))

@[frflow_defs] def apart (x : Booking) (x_1 : Booking) : Prop :=
  ((¬(x.room = x_1.room)) ∨ (∀ (x_2 : Int), (¬((Rooms.covers x x_2) ∧ (Rooms.covers x_1 x_2)))))

@[frflow_defs] def covers (x : Booking) (x_1 : Int) : Prop :=
  ((x.start ≤ x_1) ∧ (x_1 < x.«end»))
